PlatformEntry

Co-branded entry point from a Rede Sesc de Educação surface into the Plataforma Sesc Sab.IA. One click from a marketing page to the platform's home — see docs/sabia-platform.md.

Live example

The example needs JavaScript; the usage below shows the markup.

Usage

The bridge from a Rede Sesc de Educação page into the Plataforma Sesc Sab.IA — the network's adaptive-learning platform. Use it once per page, near the end of a marketing or programme page, so a student, family or teacher reaches the platform in one click.

<PlatformEntry
  href="https://…"                                   // ask Sesc for the real URL
  logoSrc="assets/logos/sabia-wordmark-cream.svg"
  title="Aprendizagem que acompanha cada estudante"
  ctaLabel="Acessar a plataforma"
  note="Acesso para estudantes, famílias e educadores da Rede."
/>

<PlatformEntry tone="cream" logoSrc="assets/logos/sabia-wordmark-purple.svg" />

Two tones: purple (solid Sab.IA purple band — the default, for a page's closing CTA) and cream (quiet block inside the page flow). Pair the lockup with the tone: the cream wordmark on purple, the purple wordmark on cream. Without logoSrc it falls back to a text eyebrow.

Write the copy about what the student gets, not about the technology: "acompanhamento contínuo da aprendizagem", not "plataforma de IA adaptativa com analytics". Sab.IA is where learning is diagnosed, personalised and followed; the TOTVS portal is where enrollment, secretaria and finance live — never send someone here for a matrícula task.

href defaults to #, which is a placeholder, not a value: flag it to the user until Sesc supplies the real platform URL.

Plain HTML contract

Native section attributes and the forwarded ref target .rse-platform-entry. Add .rse-platform-entry--cream for the cream variant. The Sab.IA surfaces and their paired foregrounds remain fixed across themes. Hover is CSS; no JavaScript is required.

<section class="rse-platform-entry" aria-label="Plataforma Sesc Sab.IA">
  <div class="rse-platform-entry__content">
    <span class="rse-platform-entry__eyebrow">Plataforma Sesc Sab.IA</span>
    <h2 class="rse-platform-entry__title">Aprendizagem que acompanha cada estudante</h2>
    <p class="rse-platform-entry__description">Acompanhamento contínuo da aprendizagem.</p>
    <p class="rse-platform-entry__note">Acesso para a comunidade da Rede.</p>
  </div>
  <a class="rse-platform-entry__link" href="#">Acessar a plataforma</a>
</section>

Replace the eyebrow with img.rse-platform-entry__logo when using an approved lockup, with alt="Plataforma Sesc Sab.IA". The note is optional. Replace the placeholder URL before publishing.

Props

PropTypeRequiredNotes
hrefstring—Where the platform lives. Ask Sesc for the real URL — the default # is a placeholder.
logoSrcstring—Sab.IA lockup, e.g. assets/logos/sabia-wordmark-cream.svg on purple
logoAltstring—
eyebrowstring—Uppercase label shown when no logoSrc is given
titlestring—
descriptionstring—
ctaLabelstring—
tonepurple cream—purple = solid Sab.IA purple band; cream = quiet block on a cream page
notestring—Small print under the description (audience, access conditions)

Also accepts every attribute of React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, a ref and className.
